name: comp-589
title: Breadcrumb Version Header
description: A slim dark header with a two-part breadcrumb for account type and project, each opening a small dropdown, followed by Dashboard, Docs, API reference links, a gear and an avatar.
use: A workspace header must show and switch the active account and project while keeping docs links handy.
avoid: Both selectors are limited to a few fixed options each, and the nav links are static placeholders.
a11y: Both selects are labelled; naming for the gear and avatar depends on the separate components used. (keyboard: yes, labels: partial, reduced motion: not handled)
looks: A slim dark header starts with two ghost buttons, Personal and Main project, each with an up-down chevron and split by a slash, then Dashboard, Docs and API reference links, a gear icon and a round avatar.
behaves: Each breadcrumb button opens a small dropdown of account types or projects with a tick on the current choice. Picking one updates that label; the plain nav links only brighten on hover.
customise: Account and project options, defaults and nav labels are written in the file; the settings and user menus come from separate pieces.
weight: light: Two small selects, three links and two icon buttons.
